# New Scotland Strength

> New Scotland Strength is a personal training and strength coaching business in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada, run by coach Josh Dunbar. It offers in-person 1-on-1 personal training across the Halifax Regional Municipality (Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville), online coaching anywhere, custom training programs, meal plans, and strongman and powerlifting competition preparation.

## Coach

- Name: Josh Dunbar, personal trainer and strength coach
- Certifications: ACE Certified Personal Trainer, Level 1 Nutrition Coach, Senior Fitness Specialist, Size Inclusive Training
- Experience: over 20 years of strength training
- Competition record: competitive strongman with multiple Nova Scotia and Atlantic titles and multiple top-five finishes at the national level; highly experienced in both strongman and powerlifting

## Who it is for

- Beginners and people returning to training after time away
- Women and men of all ages, including older adults
- People focused on weight loss and body composition, not only strength
- Athletes preparing for strongman or powerlifting competition (a specialty)
- Clients with injuries or physical limitations (programming is adapted)

## Services

- 1-on-1 personal training: in-person, hands-on coaching with form correction and progression. Sessions run out of a private studio in Herring Cove, with additional gym access in Burnside and Halifax's north end. No separate gym membership is needed.
- Online training + meal plan: monthly online coaching with a custom training plan, meal plan support, and regular check-ins. Clients log training in a shared Google Sheet; form checks and 24/7 support are handled over WhatsApp. Programs can be built for little or no equipment.
- Custom training program: a personalized strength program built around the client's goals, schedule, and training history.
- Meal plan: a custom nutrition plan for clients who want dietary structure.

Pricing depends on the service and training frequency and is discussed in a consultation. Payment is by e-transfer (online services) or e-transfer and Stripe (in-person).

## Service area

- In person: Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville, and the wider Halifax Regional Municipality (HRM), Nova Scotia
- Online: anywhere in Nova Scotia, across Canada, and beyond
